items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I had to run and get him that morning... we played the 4th, 5th and 6th of July in Bures... we took this fella

ctx.x: Do you remember when he died of? What his trouble was? No I know. I never got to know him. I just wondered.

I know he had high fever. I mean when we went there that morning he was just talking about his aid. I mean he wanted to get up. He told his wife, I got to go with that man. I got his deposit. I got to go look like I can see him. I mean when we come back he was late. Because we played the 4th, 5th and 6th of July in Bures. Went to Boerwood for him. Coming back we stopped at Venus. Just less jobs like Bures. Well we took this fella. I don't know if you remember him. He used to call him Jamaica fella. He called him…
